title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU-Mexico Initiative on Preventing Gender Based Violence and for Economic Empowerment of Women in Mexico

description.narrative: The proposed action intends to support the Mexican Government in its efforts to prevent, address, punish and eradicate violence against women and girls. It adopts a gender-transformative, intersectional and culturally relevant approach, addressing unequal power relations, harmful gender norms and structural discrimination that perpetuate violence in Mexico. It will specifically support reducing the feminicide in Mexico and physical and sexual violence against women, adolescents, and girls, particularly those who face multiple vulnerabilities, such as: women living in poverty or in rural and/or marginalized communities; women of indigenous peoples or Afro-descent; those in situations of migration or detention; those living with a disability or forming part of the LGTBQI+ community. It will prioritize closing legal gaps between international human rights standards and uneven state-level implementation, with special attention to harmonization of criminal typologies, investigative standards and victim protection across the federative entities. The action will improve the capacity of the public institutions in charge of legislate, administration of justice and citizen security, education and private companies to: a) prevent and respond to violence against women and girls to address efficiently Gender Based Violence and, b) promote the economic inclusion and autonomy of women as a key pathway for preventing and escaping GBV. It will also strengthen accountability mechanisms, survivor-centred services, and inter-institutional coordination to reduce impunity and secondary victimization, including safeguards to prevent risk of violence against survivors and women Human Rights Defenders.The proposed action is embedded in the Priority Area I of the Regional MIP ¿ Mexico chapter, in particular the specific area of support to democratic governance, including rule of law, fight against corruption, human rights (including the eradication of gender-based violence and human trafficking and exploitation, LGBTIQ and indigenous rights), justice, citizen security and migration in Mexico.Furthermore, the proposed action intends to contribute to the objective 2 of regional MIP Priority area 4: ¿Enhance the rule of law and the fight against transnational organised crime across the region, with a full respect of international human rights principles¿.The Action directly contributes to SDGs 5, 8, 10, 16 and 17, is aligned with the EU Gender Action Plan III ¿ GAP III and Mexico¿s National Gender Equality and Violence Prevention frameworks and incorporates the sustainability and institutionalization lessons highlighted by the Spotlight Initiative.The Action is consistent with the EU¿s NDICI¿Global Europe approach to gender-responsive external action. The Action also contributes to the implementation of the Human Rights and Democracy Country Strategy Mexico 2021 ¿ 2027 particularlly to the priority of promotion of women¿s rights and gender equality.Related to the GAP III the Action covers two of the four thematic areas of engagement established by the Country Level Implementation Plan - Mexico 2021 ¿ 2027 linked to ensuring freedom from all forms of gender-based violence and promoting economic and social rights and empowering girls and women
